files.name: W08-run-a-readable
files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game locomotion sprite sheet, nonviolent carrying pose.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the frozen W07 RUN HALF-A sheet. Image 2 is the companion half only as identity and equal physical bow-length reference; NEVER copy its leg poses into Image 1. Image 3 is the equipment design atlas. Image 4 shows the approved W08 prop in hand, use ONLY the bow design, not its body/poses/background.
Change ONLY the plain bow in Image 1 into the THIRD bow from the LEFT in Image 3, the silverwood deer/vine bow with carved silver recurved limb tips, pale carved wood, a distinct GREEN crystal seated beside the leather grip. Use this exact third-column design, not the adjacent violet bow. Retain the original left-hand grip point and wrist/arm position, all fingers around the real grip, string facing inward toward the character, the right hand empty, the existing back quiver and arrows unchanged. It is low-carry running with a relaxed undrawn bow, not aiming or firing. Keep one coherent bow per person and consistent physical limb-tip distance through all sixteen cells and the companion half, approximately the full bow length of the frozen target, about70% of standing body height. Any perspective foreshortening must follow the target, never shrink into a toy in alternate phases. Crystal/framework sparkle is restrained and attached to the prop, no haze or large glow.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE LITERALLY to Image 1: identical face/age/head size, slim adult body and long legs, neck/shoulders/waist, silhouette, same exact sixteen poses, phase offsets and boot contacts, camera, pixel body scale and every position. The teal green cape, deep cool brown leather armor, ivory sleeves, gray-brown trousers, neutral steel shoulder plate, natural bright skin, stitching and realistic painted materials remain unchanged. Do not use any older stocky/chibi body.
Output exactly1024x1536 with4equal columns x4rows; rows down/right/up/left. Preserve HALF-A four consecutive original run phases in each row; this is phases0..3, not a stand or walk and not duplicated phase0. One complete isolated body plus bow per cell, no clipping or neighboring fragments.
True transparent RGBA output: every empty backdrop and gutter alpha0, retain foreground alpha and fine bow string antialiasing. NO backdrop, gray/brown wash, checkboard paint, floor/shadow cloud, vignette, divider, text, numbers, labels, panels, watermark. The only requested visual change is the decorative bow prop.
